notForProduction: Development only. Nothing in the production analyzer reads this file, and no coordinate in it is available to the automatic URL->model flow.

method.frame: The STAGE WEB-PIVOT-02 building frame: +X east, +Y up, +Z south, origin at the outer face of the main body's north-west corner. Plan-right is +X and plan-down is +Z, which is how ARCHON draws these plans (north up, entrance facade at the bottom).
method.calibration: scripts/plan-measure.ts, presets `ground` and `upper`. Ground: px 58..513 = 0..12.05 m across, px 259..735 = 0..12.60 m down (37.7593 / 37.7778 px per m, 0.05% apart). Upper: px 47..345.2 = 0..7.90 m across, px 195.3..670.8 = 0..12.60 m down (37.7468 / 37.7381 px per m, 0.02% apart). One pixel is 0.0265 m, which is the resolution of every SOURCE_DERIVED number below.
method.howWallsWereFound: Every wall position was read twice: once as black ink in the raster (scripts/plan-measure.ts row/col/segments, luminance < 95 so that furniture and the watermark are excluded) and once, where a printed chain covers it, from the chain. Where the two disagree the chain wins and the disagreement is recorded in the wall's `source`.

method.publishedAreaConvention: The published room areas are NOT raw plan-polygon areas. Two rooms settle it exactly: the attic Pokoj printed 344 x 449 has a raw area of 15.4456 m2 and is published as 15.13 m2, and the attic Pralnia printed 344 x 202 has a raw area of 6.9488 m2 and is published as 6.73 m2. Both are reproduced to the centimetre by A - P*d + 4*d^2 with d = 0.02 m, which is the plan area measured to finished surfaces with 20 mm of finish on every face. The cross-check therefore reports the raw polygon area, the same polygon inset by 20 mm, and the published figure, and classifies against the inset one. The rule is a finding about the source, not an input to any geometry here: no polygon was moved to make it fit.

statusMeaning.SOURCE_EXACT: a number printed on the drawing, read directly
statusMeaning.SOURCE_CORROBORATED: measured in the raster AND confirmed by a printed chain that closes on it
statusMeaning.SOURCE_DERIVED: measured in the raster with scripts/plan-measure.ts; no printed chain covers it
statusMeaning.ASSUMPTION: a modelling choice the drawing does not settle
statusMeaning.UNRESOLVED: the drawing does not settle it and no choice was made

method.note: Every element here was transcribed by hand from the two published floor plans. Nothing in this file is produced by the automatic analyzer, and nothing in the automatic analyzer reads it.

stairs.source: The shaft is the 2.08 x 1.98 m zone east of the hall between gw_pantry_south (measured free end at x 6.435, so the shaft's north edge is the measured top-step line at z 6.78..6.99) and gw_boiler_north's north face at z 8.77. The ground plan draws tread nosings running across X in the southern band and across Z at the east end, which is a U with winders; the upper plan's Schody compartment sits directly above. Subtracting this footprint from the circulation space leaves 9.28 m2 against the published Hol of 9.18 m2, which is the independent check that the footprint is the right size and in the right place.
stairs.simplification: Modelled as two straight flights joined at the east end, 17 risers of 0.18 m. The drawing's winders are NOT represented: the turn is modelled as a change of flight rather than as tapered treads. This is a stated simplification, not a reading of the source.

observedButNotModelled: Winders at the turn of the stair: the ground plan draws tapered treads, and the model uses two straight flights.
The balcony beyond the south wall on the upper floor, which is why the upper plan is drawn deeper than the building.
Fitted furniture, sanitary ware, the fireplace insert and the car, all of which the plans draw and none of which is building fabric.
Window and door callouts on the external walls (90/230, 140/140, 234/303, 78/118, 270/320 and the rest), which belong to the exterior shell and to a later stage.
The ground-floor flue block beside the fireplace, which the raster shows at roughly x 5.39..5.97, z 4.51..4.99 and which straddles the salon's south boundary.
unresolved: The exact west edge of the ground-floor hall where it meets the open-plan kitchen: the drawing prints no chain across it, and 4.11 m is the free end of gw_kitchen_south rather than a measured room boundary.

The ground-floor pantry's published gross area of 2.42 m2 against the 2.21 m2 the measured walls enclose: the drawing shows the stair soffit over its south-east corner, and the published figure appears to include floor the model gives to the stair.

The boundary between the upper Korytarz and Schody, which no wall draws; the model splits them at uw_stair_north's west end and the published pair 6.17 + 5.63 does not match the pair the model derives.

The published net areas of the attic rooms (12.57 against 15.13 and so on), which apply a headroom rule the plans do not state. The model reports the raw and finished plan areas and never the net one.
Whether the kotlownia/garage door is a fire door and how it is detailed; only its position is read here, and it is not cut, because its host is the STAGE WEB-PIVOT-02 exterior shell.
